entries.reason: the release carries no CommandEvent class at all: read from 6.1.3's own MediaPlayer with tools/mach32_methods.py, no class whose name holds CommandEvent exists in any of the 236 and none of the 41 categories, with a nonsense selector absent as the control. A class the release does not have is new code and cannot shadow anything, so there is nothing native for it to be - it is carried.
entries.effect: nil is not possible for a NSTimeInterval, so an event the port builds and does not set answers 0, which is the value the type's zero is; readwrite in the port so the event can carry the position it is about, where the header has it readonly
